# radstrat

> radstrat is a free online CS2 (Counter-Strike 2) strat planner and tactics board. Players, in-game leaders (IGLs), teams, coaches and esports organisations use it to plan executes, retakes, setups and smoke lineups on 2D radar maps, split the round into phases, and share the plan with teammates in one link. No account is needed; optional Steam sign-in saves strats to an account so they show up on every PC (only the SteamID is stored).

## What it does
- Maps: all CS2 Active Duty maps (Mirage, Dust II, Inferno, Nuke, Ancient, Anubis, Train, Overpass) plus Cache, on Valve's radar overviews. Nuke has both levels: Nuke (A) is the upper level, Nuke (B) the lower level.
- Objects: teammates and enemies (numbered 1-5 with roles), movement routes, smokes, flashes, molotovs, HE grenades, the C4, sight cones (wide, normal, narrow), pen drawings (freehand, lines, arrows, rectangles, dashed), text notes and lineup pins linking to a YouTube video or image.
- Phases: a strat is split into phases (for example default, execute, post-plant). A new phase starts with everything already placed, with players where their routes ended. Play runs through every phase in order and animates the routes.
- Sharing and invites: the whole strat is stored in the link. A view link lets teammates watch and play it and save their own copy; an edit link opens it in the other person's planner, and when they send their edit link back you can update your version with their changes (your old version is kept as a copy). Changes are not synced live. No account is needed.
- Saving: strats are saved automatically in the browser on the device they were made on. A backup file (Save backup / Open file) keeps them safe or moves them to another device.
- Playbooks: strats can be grouped into playbooks (for example "Mirage T") with a type (default, execute, split, retake, setup, anti-eco, pistol round), searched and filtered by map, side, type and playbook. A whole playbook can be shared as one link or a file.
- Spawns: "Place all five at spawn" uses real competitive CS2 spawn positions (spawn data by setpos.gg) on Mirage, Dust II, Inferno, Nuke (both levels), Ancient and Anubis; players dropped near a spawn snap onto it.

## Coming soon (not available yet)
- AI Analyze: upload a CS2 demo and get what went well and what went wrong, compared with the planned strat, with tips to improve the plan.

## Facts
- Price: free.
- Platform: web browser; editing works best on a computer, viewing works on phones.
- Not affiliated with Valve. Map radar images are © Valve Corporation.
